BiblicalUsage: Oneg is luxury, delight, pleasantness. In Isaiah 13:22 the dragons cry in Babylon's pleasant palaces, and in Isaiah 58:13 the sabbath is called a delight, the holy of the Lord, honourable.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe delight belongs to God first, and the luxury of Babylon ends in dragons while the delight of the sabbath endures.
